nodes.title: PERSONA FACE FINISH · START HERE
widgets_values:
PERSONA FACE FINISH · BFS HEAD SWAP FOR FLUX.2 KLEIN 9B

1. TARGET 4K IMAGE: upload the finished image. Right-click it → Open in MaskEditor.
2. Paint WHITE over the entire face/head that may change, plus a narrow edge around it. Save the mask to the node.
3. PERSONA REFERENCE: select the closest angle—front, three-quarter left/right, or profile left/right.
4. Queue. The official BFS target-first/persona-second conditioning regenerates only a 1024×1024 crop; Crop-and-Stitch blends that region back into the untouched full-resolution original.
5. Inspect the Before / After slider. The saved result keeps the input dimensions.

MASK CHOICE
• Face only: paint forehead, eyebrows, eyes, nose, cheeks, mouth, chin and a small skin border. Preserve generated hair.
• Full head: include hair, ears, jaw and neck transition. This gives stronger persona consistency but may replace hairstyle.
• Keep the mask away from clothes and background unless they must change.

BFS CONTRACT
Picture 1 is always the target crop. Picture 2 is always the persona reference. LoRA strength 1.0, LCM, FLUX.2 scheduler, four steps and CFG 1 are the author's starting settings.

The six bundled references are the selected canonical views from face_dataset/03_dataset_candidates.

widgets_values:
head_swap: start with Picture 1 as the base image, keeping its lighting, environment, and background. remove the head from Picture 1 completely and replace it with the head from Picture 2, strictly preserving the hair, eye color, and nose structure of Picture 2. copy the direction of the eyes, head rotation, and micro-expressions from Picture 1. Keep the body, clothing, pose, framing, and background intact. high quality, sharp realistic photographic detail.

Preserve Picture 1's expression, camera perspective, illumination direction, exposure, skin shading and neck placement. Blend the transferred identity naturally without a visible seam.
